Scope of Work: The vendor shall carry out structural welding, bore repair, bush replacement, and restor ation work of JCB 3DX Super as per the buyer's requirements. 2. Quality of Workmanship: All welding, boring, bush fitting, and restoration work shall be carried out profe ssionally to ensure proper strength, alignment, and durability. 3. Work at Buyer's Premises: The work shall be carried out at the buyer's premises/workshop, as directed b y the buyer. The vendor shall arrange the required manpower, tools, and equipment. 4. Material Quality: All bushes and other materials used shall be of approved quality and shall be subject t

o the buyer's inspection and approval. 5. Safety Responsibility: The vendor shall be responsible for the safety of its workers, tools, and equipment during execution of the work and shall follow all applicable safety precautions. 6. Damage Liability: Any damage caused to the JCB 3DX Super or its components due to the vendor's negli gence or improper workmanship shall be rectified by the vendor at its own cost. 7. Warranty: The vendor shall provide a minimum warranty of 12 months on the completed work from the date of satisfactory completion and acceptance by the buyer. 8. Defect Rectification: Any defect arising from poor welding, improper bore repair, incorrect bush fitting, o r faulty workmanship during the warranty period shall be rectified by the vendor free of cost. 9. Inspection and Acceptance: The buyer reserves the right to inspect the work at any stage. Final accepta nce shall be subject to satisfactory completion of all specified work. 10. Completion and Payment: The vendor shall complete the work within the stipulated time. Payment shal l be released as per agreed terms after satisfactory completion and acceptance by the buyer. .
